notes.title: Announcing Coloring Voxels!
notes.content:
[h2]Coloring Pixels 2![/h2]
The long-awaited sequel to Coloring Pixels is coming soon!
Taking your favourite coloring game from 2D Pixels to 3D Voxels! Experience color-by-numbers like never before in our evolution of the Coloring genre!


[h2]Coloring Voxels[/h2]
Taking Coloring Pixels to a whole new level in the highly anticipated 3D sequel! Don't just colour the outside of a 3D object; build it yourself, block by block! Build up your creations layer by layer, level by level, to create a whole diorama tens of thousands of voxels big.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33218193/f982614ca36958b6acfa42c261b808537c2187f5.gif[/img] 

Relive the calming and creative atmosphere of Coloring Pixels in our new 3D-based coloring game! From the music and art style to the gameplay and satisfying progression, relax and get creative with every level you build, in a format you already know and love.

Wishlist here to stay up-to-date with development and get involved with Steam Next Fest! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634590?utm_source=announce1_wool


[h3]Patreon Early Access[/h3]
If you can't wait for Next Fest or the full release in August, then check out our Patreon page here, where the top-tier supporters can get access to the Coloring Voxels Demo right now!
[url=https://www.patreon.com/c/toastielabs]https://www.patreon.com/c/toastielabs[/url]

notes.title: WooLoop in 2024
notes.content:
[h1]New DLC, Achievements and more![/h1]

A massive thank you to all of you for supporting WooLoop over the year! It has almost been a whole year since we released WooLoop last January already!

2023 saw 12 DLC, 372 Levels and 129,000 unique players playing WooLoop over the year! That is absolutely staggering for a small indie studio like us! Thank you all so much!

Your support is what motivates us and allows us to keep on doing what we love. Making games for you all to enjoy. 💖

[h1]DLC in 2024[/h1]

When we released WooLoop way back in January 2023, we committed to 12 additional DLC Galleries. From Fantasy, Food, Nature and to the most recent, Advent. We have achieved that goal! 

Thank you all for your interest and for playing along with us throughout the year.

[h2]But what does that mean for the future of WooLoop?[/h2]

Don't worry! We are now committed to an additional 6 DLC that we will be releasing over 2024, starting this January with the upcoming Science Gallery! 🔬

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/5febbc3bf3c174433cec7664167ab033ccd3b877.jpg[/img]

We will be releasing DLC on a bi-monthly schedule all the way up to December, so there'll be plenty more wrapping and looping for you to get tangled up in.

[h2]Get involved[/h2]

The Science DLC was voted for by our very own [url=https://www.patreon.com/toastielabs]Patreon[/url] supporters! 

But you don't need to be a Patreon to have your say. Join our Discord and share with us what Gallery ideas you would like to see in WooLoop.

These suggestions go into a list for all our Discord users to vote on, the top 5 voted of these suggestions will be passed over to our Patreons every other month to make the final decision on what DLC we will all see next!

So don't wait around, join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/toastielabs-750363631279014079]Discord[/url] now and have your say on what themes and styles we should do next in WooLoop!

[h1]Achievements[/h1]

A long-awaited change is coming right now!

Upon release of WooLoop, we were only able to add 100 achievements, and these didn't even count towards your Steam profile! Boooo! 👎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/958660c990b0f37c1f9e5fb51acbb598c9e97640.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/48db94eae2b1724da3336a49e7350df72860b8f5.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/958660c990b0f37c1f9e5fb51acbb598c9e97640.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/a6cb991363a2282d4fd2c0a6dd2fb48421188c20.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/5aaa9aec3adb412002d889a444a04db604c288fa.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/958660c990b0f37c1f9e5fb51acbb598c9e97640.png[/img]

Thankfully, due to your continued love and support of WooLoop, Steam has recognised our game and we can now add more Steam achievements that will also be counted on your profiles! Yayyy! 🥳

We have been hard at work this week making all of the achievement icons and getting them uploaded to Steam. Make sure you launch your game and reopen any completed levels to trigger the new achievements.

[b]Note[/b]: [i]We have focused on getting the achievements uploaded in English only for the moment so that they are available ASAP. 

To our beloved worldwide players who play WooLoop in other languages than English, we will be making sure all the achievements are localised to all of the Steam-supported languages soon.tm

Thank you for your patience! 💞[/i]

[h1]More![/h1]

The best way we can think for you to get more WooLoop; is to make it possible to play WooLoop wherever you go!

That's why this year, WooLoop will be coming to Nintendo Switch!

Release dates and more detailed information will be available soon so make sure you keep an eye on your inbox for more news on WooLoop on the Nintendo Switch! 

[h1]Thank you![/h1]

WooLoop, and ToastieLabs, wouldn't be where it is today without your love and support.

So from all of us here at ToastieLabs, thank you!

[h3]"Why is it snowing on my Artwork?"[/h3]

If you have played our other titles, like Coloring Pixels, you will know we all love the Christmas Season and like to celebrate in style! WooLoop is no exception.
You will notice that no matter what image you are playing, there are snowflakes falling all around your beautiful creations and melting at the bottom of the screen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/6e8ab665202dc767be9d98243a39c07c4ff6b5f7.gif[/img]

During the whole month of December, from the 1st to the 31st (and for every December yet to come!), to get us all in the Christmas spirit we have added this wintery theme for you all you enjoy! 
If you find the snow too distracting, we have you covered. You can choose to take part by enabling or disabling "Seasonal Effects" on the settings page.

The seasonal effect will play on the Advent Gallery all year round so don't worry about missing out!

[h3]Advent Calendars![/h3]

As it is officially December, we can start opening our Advent Calendars! 
This includes this month's "Advent Gallery" DLC! With this DLC, all images are locked behind a numbered door so we can count down the days until Christmas one WooLoop image at a time! We've even added 3 more images to the DLC at no extra cost to make sure you can count down all 24 days to Christmas!

Skystead Ranch is a casual, relaxing ranching game set in the skies! Take to your very own Skystead, a big magical floating island amongst the clouds, where mysterious and wonderous creatures known as Skylets live. Learn their ways and make a home for you all!

Skystead Ranch is still a very much work in progress. All of the imagery and game footage you see is pre-release Demo so the end result may vary.

You can follow our week-to-week progress on our YouTube channel with weekly update Vlogs. 
Make sure you Wishlist the game on Steam and follow the Community Hub to stay up-to-date with every bit of important news and monthly progress reports.

[h1]WooLoop Game Pricing[/h1]

[b]WooLoop will be Free![/b]

Here at ToastieLabs, we believe games should be for everyone. With that in mind, like some of our other titles on Steam, we release games for free and offer optional DLC at the lowest price we can on Steam $0.99!

The game will be Free and offer 5 Galleries (plus 1 Bonus Gallery) of string art to complete! Each Gallery will contain 21 unique pieces of art for you to create.
After some quick maths, this means you will get over 100 levels to play for free when you download WooLoop!

[h2]DLC[/h2]
In order to provide even more levels for you to play, we are committing to offering 12 months of DLC, 1 DLC for each month of 2023!
Each DLC will contain a new Gallery of 21 pieces of art, we are going to be offering these DLC at $0.99 (the lowest price Steam allows).
Each DLC will launch on the 4th Friday of each month, with the exception of December's planned DLC "Advent", which will feature 24 levels and slight changes to the release schedule which we will confirm at a later date.

notes.title: What is WooLoop?
notes.content:
[h1]WooLoop[/h1]

If you already follow our other games on Steam, you may have seen snippets of WooLoop in our Dev Vlogs over the past year. A project Rob started in his spare time last Christmas!

A different take on our beloved game Coloring Pixels. The same relaxing and rewarding game feel but this time in a more creatively expressive manner!


[h2]What is WooLoop?[/h2]

WooLoop is a game of creation. You build up great works of art by dragging your yarn in loops around various pins in your canvas. Slowly, one thread at a time, patterns will form, until eventually, you construct a beautifully woven masterpiece.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/1af4d8c0bce21d28f0036710a7bf2a832f57658e.jpg[/img]

Wrap, weave, and wind your wool! Build works of art strand by strand, one loop at a time, in this tranquil game of craftsmanship. Draw inspiration from the large exhibition of levels available and unwind with the soothing soundtrack.


[h2]Follow Our Progress![/h2]
WooLoop is still a work in progress. Make sure you check out our Weekly Dev Vlogs on [url=https://youtube.com/c/toastielabs]YouTube[/url] as well as Wishlisting the game on Steam to be kept up to date with all of the progress we make!

We are planning to hold weekly Developer Broadcasts here on the Steam store page every Friday around 1 pm British Time so make sure you tune in for live interaction about the game!

Milestone updates will be available here on our [url=https://www.toastielabs.co.uk/]Website[/url] and on our Social Media.


[h2]Release Date[/h2]
We are preparing to offer a Steam Demo during the [b]October Next Fest[/b] next month! 

The full release of the game will be in [b]early 2023[/b], with exact dates to be confirmed


[h2]Patreon[/h2]
A message to our [url=https://www.patreon.com/toastielabs]Patreons[/url], as promised in your tier offers, we will be releasing early access build to our Toastie Heros a few weeks before release and a Beta Access build to our Toastie Members shortly after!
